registry.item_title: Number of Participants With Event: Atrial Fibrillation (Omega-3 Comparison Only)

item_title_witness.text: Number of Participants With Event: Atrial Fibrillation (Omega-3 Comparison Only)

notes: Selected the posted outcome measure including fatal and non-fatal atrial fibrillation during the randomized treatment phase (mean 7.4 years). Group IDs are local to this measure; OG000 is Omega-3 and OG001 is Placebo Omega-3, each pooling across aspirin allocation. The held CT.gov results extract repeats the same counts. Other Arrhythmia is a separate measure that explicitly excludes atrial fibrillation; no atrial fibrillation event term was found in adverseEventsModule.
